a.lede: In the face of strong demand and device shortages, Sony has decided to filter PlayStation 5 Pro purchasers in Japan using a lottery system.
a.title: Sony Japan tries an anti-scalper lottery system for PS5 Pro orders, locks systems behind a 60-hour playtime requirement

b.lede: Gamers in Japan will have to prove they actually use their PS consoles to be able to buy a PS5 Pro.
b.title: Sony implements a lottery system to deal with the PS5 Pro shortage in Japan
